sentences.en: I was completely bewildered by his sudden change of mood.
sentences.zh: 他突然情绪的变化让我完全摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: Judging from his expression, he is in a bad mood.
sentences.zh: 从他的表情来看，他心情不好。

sentences.en: I became quite astonished by his sudden change of mood.
sentences.zh: 他突然的情绪变化让我大吃一惊。
